text: Death is a transformation resulting from a special notification from another; similarly, other conditions such as loss of memory occur due to the mental power of ghosts and the like. For indeed, disorders such as loss of memory, dream-visions, and spirit-possession occur in others due to the mental power of ghosts and others, as well as through the mental power of those possessing supernatural abilities. For example, Sarana experienced a dream-vision due to the influence of the venerable Mahakatyayana.
